structure_proposals.why: On 2 September you pressed dumbbells in this slot and wrote "New gym. No smith machine. Dumbbell press", so this renames the Push B opener to the dumbbell shoulder press you are actually doing and asks for 4 sets of 8 to 10 instead of the smith bar's 6 to 8 — it will open at the weight you are already pressing on Push A, so nothing about the load changes, only the name and the rep ask.

You ran this slot with a barbell on 5 September and wrote "Barbell" on the card, so this renames the Legs B opener to the deadlift — the only barbell hinge anywhere in the app's exercise list — and keeps the same four sets at 8 to 10 reps, well clear of the heavy fives you pull on Pull A; the first Legs B card after this comes up blank and asks you to set the working weight, which is the one you already used on 5 September.
